title: Tiny, cute compass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- outer body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='38' fill='#c8862a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='34' fill='#f2d27a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='#1b2a4a'/>
  <!-- compass rose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='22' fill='#243a63'/>
  <!-- north needle -->
  <polygon points='50,28 56,50 50,46 44,50' fill='#ff5b5b'/>
  <!-- south needle -->
  <polygon points='50,72 56,50 50,54 44,50' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <!-- east west -->
  <polygon points='72,50 50,56 54,50 50,44' fill='#5fd0ff'/>
  <polygon points='28,50 50,56 46,50 50,44' fill='#5fd0ff'/>
  <!-- center hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='5' fill='#ffd34d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <!-- cardinal ticks -->
  <rect x='48' y='17' width='4' height='6' rx='1' fill='#9fd8ff'/>
  <rect x='48' y='77' width='4' height='6' rx='1' fill='#9fd8ff'/>
  <rect x='17' y='48' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#9fd8ff'/>
  <rect x='77' y='48' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#9fd8ff'/>
  <!-- little shine -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='34' r='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
